## Automated Tests Required

### [Story Title] — Logic

**Test file path**: per `testing.patterns` (e.g. `apps/api/src/goals/goal-plan.test.ts`), else
`tests/unit/[feature]/[story-slug].test.[ext]`

**What to test**:
- [Rule from the PRD's `## Business Rules & Calculations` — e.g., "monthly debit = target ÷ months,
  rounded up to the nearest KRW 10: KRW 1,000,000 over 3 months → KRW 333,340"]
- [Each named state transition — e.g., goal `active → paused → active`, `active → completed`]
- [Each side effect that should / should not occur — e.g., completing a goal cancels the auto-debit schedule]

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Zero / minimum input values (e.g., 0 months remaining, KRW 0 target)
- Maximum / boundary input values (e.g., the Free plan's active-goal limit, the largest allowed amount)
- Invalid or missing input (e.g., negative amount, unknown goal id)
- [PRD `## Edge Cases` — e.g., month-end debit date on 29–31, KST/UTC day boundary]

**Estimated test count**: ~[N] unit tests

---

### [Story Title] — Integration

**Test file path**: `tests/integration/[feature]/[story-slug].test.[ext]` and/or
`tests/contract/[feature]/` (or per `testing.patterns`)

**What to test**:
- [Handler + database — e.g., "`POST /goals` persists the goal and returns 201 with the contract schema"]
- [Contract — the story's `**API Contract**` operation checked against `docs/api/openapi.yaml`]
- [Authorization — a request for another user's goal id is refused (403/404), never served (BOLA)]
- [Idempotency / retry — e.g., the same Toss Payments webhook delivered twice records one deposit]
- [Third-party adapter against its sandbox or a recorded fake — e.g., Kakao OAuth token exchange]

---

### [Story Title] — E2E

**Test file path**: `tests/e2e/[journey]/[journey].spec.ts` (Playwright) or the Maestro / Detox flow
for the app

**Journey**: [a critical user journey from `docs/ops/slo.md` `## Critical User Journeys` (or
`design/product/user-journey.md`) — e.g., sign up with Kakao → create a goal → authorise automatic
debit → see the first deposit]

**Environment**: [staging URL or preview deploy; seeded test account (no personal data); flag states,
e.g. `goals.v2-progress-ring` on]

**What to test**:
- [Each step of the journey as a visible, asserted state — no fixed sleeps]
- [The failure branch the PRD names — e.g., auto-debit authorisation cancelled in the payment sheet]

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before QA hand-off (run via `/smoke-check`):

1. Build and boot — the web app and API start, the health endpoint returns 200, the mobile app launches to its first screen
2. Sign-in works on the test environment (e.g., email and Kakao login)
3. [Core journey introduced or changed this sprint]
4. [Feature with regression risk from this sprint's changes]
5. Integrations respond in sandbox mode (payments, email / push / 알림톡)
6. Migrations apply cleanly on a disposable database
7. Non-functional spot check — p95 latency and error rate within the `performance.*` budgets where tooling exists

## Non-Functional Checks

| Area | Scope | Target | Method | Owner |
|------|-------|--------|--------|-------|
| Performance | [operation or route — e.g., `POST /goals`] | [e.g., p95 ≤ `performance.api_p95_ms` ms] | [`/perf-profile`, `/load-test` on staging] | performance-engineer |
| Web vitals | [route — e.g., `/goals`] | [LCP / INP / CLS within `performance.lcp_ms`, `performance.inp_ms`, `performance.cls`] | [Lighthouse CI or field data] | frontend-engineer |
| Security | [operations touched] | Authorization checked on every operation; input validated | [negative tests, `/security-audit quick`] | security-engineer |
| Privacy | [new log statements, events, exports] | No personal data in logs or analytics payloads | [code review, log sample from staging] | tech-lead |
| Accessibility | [screens touched] | [`> **Target**:` of `design/accessibility-requirements.md`] | [axe results, keyboard and screen-reader pass] | accessibility-specialist |
| Localization | [new strings] | [locales in `localization.locales` — e.g., ko-KR, en-US] | [pseudo-locale run, linguistic review] | localization-lead |
| Observability | [new endpoints and jobs] | Logs, metrics and traces emitted; dashboards and alerts updated | [staging dashboard check] | sre-engineer |

If a row does not apply, keep it and write *N/A — [reason]* so the omission is visible.

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — automated test result OR retained manual evidence
- [ ] Test files exist and pass for all Logic, Integration (contract tests included) and E2E stories
- [ ] Retained evidence exists in `production/qa/evidence/[story-slug]/` for all UI and E2E stories —
      screenshots of each state touched, E2E trace, and the `Run result:` line
- [ ] Migration dry-run log exists for every story whose `**Migration**` is not `None` (every `qa.level`)
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off) — the floor at every `qa.level`
- [ ] Feature flag default recorded; analytics events fire as listed in `design/product/tracking-plan.md`
- [ ] No personal data in new log statements
- [ ] No regressions introduced — the previous sprint's journeys still pass
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review`, or TL-CODE-REVIEW through `/story-done`)
- [ ] Story file updated to `> **Status**: Complete` via `/story-done`

**Stories requiring usability or beta sign-off before close**: [list, or "None"]
